mapper.sql: SELECT s.*, p.name AS product_name, p.code AS product_code, p.version AS product_version, u.name AS unit_name FROM product_sku s JOIN product p ON p.id = s.product_id AND p.is_deleted = false JOIN product_unit u ON u.id = s.unit_id AND u.is_deleted = false
